name: keepglide
description: KeepGlide's Claude Code plugins: AskAway User, AskAway Model and the ones that follow.

plugins.name: askaway-user
plugins.description: AskAway User, a question inbox for Claude Code: agents file questions with a recommended default while you are away; you answer them in a real panel, one at a time, all at once per project.

plugins.name: askaway-model
plugins.description: AskAway Model, JEV decisions for Claude Code: the askaway-model MCP tools (request_decision, jev_classify, jev_verify, jev_score, jev_rank), the skill that formulates them, and hooks that check the gateway, remind the rule and gate risky Bash commands. Needs the local gateway from the plugin's README.
